import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem uniformContinuous_paired_two_stage_comp
  {α β γ δ : Type*} [UniformSpace α] [UniformSpace β] [UniformSpace γ] [UniformSpace δ]
  {f : α → β} {g : β → γ} {h : γ → δ} {t : Set β}
  (hf : UniformContinuous f)
  (hg : UniformContinuousOn g t)
  (hft : Set.range f ⊆ t)
  (hh : UniformContinuousOn h (Set.range (g ∘ f))) :
  UniformContinuous (fun x => (g (f x), h (g (f x)))) := by
  have hgf_on : UniformContinuousOn (g ∘ f) Set.univ := by
    refine hg.comp hf.uniformContinuousOn ?_
    intro x hx
    exact hft ⟨x, rfl⟩
  
  have hgf : UniformContinuous (g ∘ f) :=
    uniformContinuousOn_univ.mp hgf_on
  
  have hcomp_on : UniformContinuousOn (h ∘ (g ∘ f)) Set.univ := by
    refine hh.comp hgf.uniformContinuousOn ?_
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
  
  have hcomp : UniformContinuous (h ∘ (g ∘ f)) :=
    uniformContinuousOn_univ.mp hcomp_on
  
  have hpair :
      UniformContinuous (fun x => ((g ∘ f) x, (h ∘ (g ∘ f)) x)) := by
    exact hgf.prodMk hcomp
  
  simpa [Function.comp_def] using hpair
